author: Murphh
body:
Hi Doctor Who fans -
I'm trying to gather ideas for a Doctor Who party that I'm having for the premier of season 8.
So far I have:
* 3D glasses
* bow ties
* TARDIS made from cardboard box
* sonic screwdrivers (flashlight with modifications)
* Fish fingers and custard

I'm dressing up as a weeping angel. Creepy.

Any other ideas?
